issues.quote: The human plateau began to shift.
The posts flew through the feeds like hotcakes
Two hundred thousand viewers instantly jumped to two hundred and fifty.
*"Do you have kids?"* a stranger asked. *"How do you succeed when you've got four of them?"*
you can't answer like that to a follower who had most likely scraped together this fifty bucks
But fame brings responsibility, and the questions veered sharply into Tinder group-date territory.
